From scripts/collect-campaign-text.mjs; the promises in it are found by step 2.
name: James C. Moylan

pages.title: Senator Guam | Home | Senator James "Jim" Moylan
pages.text:
## A Public Servant Who Brings Honesty, Transparency, and Accountability to the Legislature
As a public servant, my priorities are the safety of our community and the economic opportunities for the people of Guam. Whether it be the cost of goods or the infrastructure needs of our schools and public hospital, I will continue to fight until the job gets done.
About Senator James "Jim" Moylan
I saw the need for fewer politicians and more individuals who will be straightforward with the people we serve. I perform my public service with full transparency to the people of Guam, with a passion for public safety in every village.
As part of my commitment to the people I represent, I’m active in the communities to help improve various elements of their lives. I value the citizens of Guam, and I’ll continue to work for better conditions and opportunities.
My experience as a soldier, parole officer, business owner, and public servant has shaped my values and priorities for the people of Guam. I support public laws that foster a safer and more business-friendly environment.
The welfare and concerns of Guam residents heavily influence the bills I introduce and endorse in office. As an active member of the governing body, I consistently strive to create a better life for the people I represent.
## Trust James “Jim” Moylan to Continue to Fight for the People of Guam
My name is James Moylan but please call me Jim, and I proudly represent the people of Guam as their Senator in the 35th Guam Legislature. My philosophy is simple, two years is not a lot of time to complete the people’s work which is why I take swift action after meeting with constituents.
## Trust James “Jim” Moylan to Fight for the People
During my brief time as your Senator, I have and will continue to fight for an improved public safety, economy, and infrastructure for the People of Guam.
Expect More in the 35th Guam Legislature
Hagatna, Guam 96910
